name: api-key-scoping-p5
prompt: how do I let a customer's API key only touch the specific resources and actions they're allowed to instead of granting full account access

chunks.content: automated a monthly restore drill from the latest database backup
added a read-through cache in front of the catalog service with a 5-minute TTL
made the settings page responsive so the sidebar collapses under 768px
sharded the events table by tenant id to spread write load
send a weekly digest summarizing each team's open tickets
canary the new pricing engine to internal accounts behind a flag
keys are minted with the narrowest set of permissions for their job so a leaked read-only reporting key can never mutate billing data
every key has its own id so a single compromised credential can be revoked or rotated without disturbing the customer's other integrations
on each request the middleware intersects the route's required permission with the key's granted scopes and returns 403 if the action isn't covered
decided each issued key carries an explicit list of permitted scopes like reads:invoices and writes:none, and the gateway rejects any call outside that grant
handle plural forms correctly when translating item-count labels
redact authorization headers from request logs before shipping them
added p99 latency tracking on the public API gateway
the third-party OAuth consent screen lists which profile fields the app is requesting before the user approves
